amendments.body: Blocking: the patch never implements chloride-aware nitrite hazard in the shrimp pathway. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:29-42` still increments `hourly_nitrite_stress_accum` from raw nitrite concentration alone, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:274-315` still applies a chloride-blind `nitrite_factor` when updating condition. `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:205-257` also still lacks any species-level chloride protection parameter. The tracked changes instead add alkalinity/budget plumbing in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12-24` and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366-385`, so two tanks with identical NO2 but different Cl will still produce identical shrimp stress and mortality. That misses the bead's core deliverable and multiple acceptance criteria.
amendments.rationale: The requested feature is chloride protection against nitrite toxicity; as submitted, the existing chloride-blind behavior is unchanged.

amendments.body: Blocking: the committed diff also omits the required explainability and regression coverage for the chloride/nitrite bead. The only tracked test change is the formatting-only edit in `crates/tank_core/tests/plant_nutrient_normalization.rs:58-63`, so there is still no committed test for low-vs-high chloride mortality, species-parameterized protection, or the salt-treatment emergency scenario. Likewise the new trace work in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239` records nitrification/alkalinity notes rather than the required NO2, chloride, effective hazard, and stress contribution. As a result, the acceptance criteria around diagnostics and automated coverage are still unmet.
amendments.rationale: Even if the intended toxicology logic were added later, the submitted patch does not provide the required observability or regression tests to keep the feature correct.

payload.summary: Reviewed the tracked diff and the key `tank_core` implementation files end-to-end. The code changes are internally consistent for alkalinity accounting, but they are scoped to a different problem: the chloride-aware nitrite hazard behavior, species parameterization, diagnostics, and committed acceptance tests for bead `tanksim-6e5.6.5` are still missing.
